title: Hosted-tenant dogfood findings · batch 2026-11-12 (tracking, kept by eval#1)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ④ a tracking parent ordered by the maintainer, verbatim in session `session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH`: 「同意，开汇总卡，交给测试席维护」. ⛔ Never dispatched; no pm state. **Kept by `eval#1`**, which found most of these cards building leave and expense apps on a hosted tenant.

## 维护者速读

- 这张卡汇总 2026-11-12 这一批在托管环境里像真实客户一样搭应用、测出来的缺陷，按用户路径分组。
- 每张子卡照常由各车道认领、修复、关闭；本卡只看全貌，不派发。
- 完成标准：子卡全关之后，测试席把同一套场景（报销、请假）在托管环境里重跑一遍，全部走通才关本卡；重跑又发现的问题开下一批次卡。

## Cards, by user path (state as of filing; the keeper refreshes)

**Upload and attachments**
- #32734 (p1) upload link issued for a record the user cannot change; page reports "attached" when nothing was
- #32754 (p1) a member cannot attach a file to their own editable record (403)
- #32711 unique violation names no field (split from #32684)
- #32712 upload-link page English-only (split from #32684)
- #32746 multi-file field truncated in half a row
- #32684 closed (file type refused as a permission error)

**Flows, approvals and read-only**
- #32666 (p1) a flow writing a read-only field publishes clean; the button does nothing
- #32667 approval request opens in an unrelated app's shell
- #32756 编辑 offered on a fully read-only record
- #32757 `run_action` returns the engine chain instead of the business refusal

**Field types, forms and lists**
- #32595 (p1) datetime typed Timestamp at authoring but a string at runtime
- #32590 (p1) a published field change does not alter the table
- #32589, #32631, #32685 closed

**Studio and publishing**
- #32755 publish dialog shows an edit as "new"
- #32610 copilot draft not reflected until reload

**AI and MCP authoring**
- #32640 `validate_expression` disagrees with the publish gate

**Console performance (staging browser pass)**
- #32633 boot from the `/_console/` root fetches twice
- #32627 every list navigation sends extra requests

**Decision cards from this batch** (`needs-user-decision`; triage gives each a fable-tier evaluation before the maintainer discusses them, per the standing order)
- #32591 agent publishing its own staged changes over MCP
- #32592 Studio showing changes staged outside the tab
- #32641 MCP agent finding a colleague for a person field
- #32686 MCP agent creating a record with a required file field
- #32747 AI client attaching a file it already holds
- #32749 console AI chat attaching an invoice photo

## Done when

Every card above is closed or ruled, and `eval#1` has re-run the same leave and expense scenarios on a hosted tenant end to end. Anything the re-run finds opens the next batch card, not new rows here.
